描述_EN: in the tang dynasty (618-907) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware. the shape of this vase shows strong influence from metalware from china's western neighbours.
描述_ZN: 在唐代（618-907），日常用具通常由石器制成，而埋葬物品则由陶器制成。 这个花瓶的形状显示了来自中国西部邻国金属制品的强烈影响。
